sentences.Amira har en sønn som er litt over ett å: Amira has a son who is a little over one year old.
Now she's out in the park with him.
She is the daughter of Amira's neighbour, Heidi.
sentences.Amira og Heidi sitter og prater mens de: Amira and Heidi sit chatting while they keep an eye on their children.
sentences.Ja, det blir spennende for hele familien: Yes, it'll be exciting for the whole family.
sentences.Skal Stina også begynne i barnehagen sna: Is Stina starting kindergarten soon too?
No, I want to wait a bit.
I think she's a bit too little.
That's why we've applied for the cash-for-care benefit.
sentences.Jeg tror det er bra for Javed å komme i: I think it's good for Javed to start kindergarten now.
sentences.Alle barn med innvandrerforeldre bør gå: All children with immigrant parents should go to kindergarten, I think.
sentences.Jeg synes det er best at alle kan bestem: I think it's best if everyone can decide for themselves.
sentences.Har du ikke lyst til å komme tilbake i j: Don't you want to go back to work?
Not yet. It'll be so stressful.
sentences.Jeg koser meg hjemme, og jeg tror det er: I'm enjoying being at home, and I think it's good for Stina to be at home a bit longer.
sentences.Jeg gleder meg til å begynne å jobbe igj: I'm looking forward to starting work again.
I miss my job and my colleagues.
sentences.Tror du ikke det blir slitsomt, da?: Don't you think it'll be tiring, though?
sentences.Hvilken klasse går Jasmin i nå?: What year is Jasmin in now?
sentences.Hun går i tredje. Og etter skolen er hun: She's in third grade. And after school she goes to the after-school club.
sentences.Ja, lykke til! Og lykke til i barnehagen: Well, good luck! And good luck at kindergarten tomorrow.
sentences.Takk skal du ha. Jeg håper at han vil tr: Thank you. I hope he'll like it.
sentences.Amira har en sønn som skal begynne i bar: Amira has a son who is about to start kindergarten.
sentences.Heidi har ei datter som ikke skal begynn: Heidi has a daughter who isn't starting yet.
sentences.Amira savner kollegaene og har lyst til: Amira misses her colleagues and wants to start working again.
Heidi says she doesn't miss her job.
